## Change

Describe the change and the affected user flows.

## Verification

Record the tested commit, checks and results.

## UI review

Apply the [UI review workflow](https://github.com/HeimaoLST/Nagi/blob/dev/docs/design/ui-review.md) when the change affects the interface or interaction. For changes outside that scope, record why UI review is not applicable.

- Candidate and reviewer
- Affected pages, states and [checklist items](https://github.com/HeimaoLST/Nagi/blob/dev/docs/design/ui-checklist.md)
- Original screenshots, action records and review report
- Verdict (pass, fail, pending or not applicable)
- Blocking findings, P2 repair plans and unverified scenes
